# NoHurtCam

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** NoHurtcam, NoHurtCam

## What it does

NoHurtCam removes the camera shake effect that plays whenever your character takes damage. By default, Minecraft tilts and briefly jerks the camera view each time you are hit — this module suppresses that animation entirely so your view stays stable during combat.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/nohurtcam). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
